response.justification: Bogdan clearly exceeds the technical bar: 15+ years of software development, deep developer-tooling and test-infrastructure work (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium curriculum, CI/CD and GitLab/Docker infrastructure), and some mobile exposure (iOS/Apple TV apps, mobile device orchestration). However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management — no direct reports, no performance/1:1 ownership, and no organizational-change leadership, which are core, explicitly required elements of this Level II Manager role. Titles are individual-contributor throughout (Senior/Staff Engineer), with leadership expressed mainly through mentoring, workshops, and founding an open-source project. Worth a screening call to probe whether the re:cinq/GISCollective roles involved team leadership, but the profile currently reads as a strong senior IC rather than an engineering manager.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD)
15+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile, desktop, embedded; well past the 8-year minimum
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: workshops, conference talks, courses, open-source founding
concerns: No demonstrated people management or direct-report experience (2-year minimum unmet)
No evidence of formal technical lead role or organizational change leadership
Mobile-platform ecosystem exposure is limited and dated (2015–2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure depth
Lack of formal technical leadership scope
